name: omp-cloudflare-workspace
description: An Open Memory Protocol v0.5 example on Cloudflare Workers and Artifacts

scripts.deploy: pnpm sdk:build && pnpm --filter omp-cloudflare run deploy
scripts.check: pnpm sdk:build && pnpm --filter omp-cloudflare check && vp check --deny-warnings && pnpm --filter omp-sdk check
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e

MEMORY_API_TOKEN.description: The private access key for this demo. Generate at least 24 characters with `openssl rand -hex 32` and save the value: you will paste it into Connect → Access key. It unlocks chat and both memory stores. Use the same value as OMP_API_TOKEN for clients.
